The Authentic Name of Eileíthyia

Scholarly reference for Eileíthyia

Greek

Εἰλείθυια

The name in its original Greek form. Εἰλείθυια carries the full phonetic and orthographic weight of the source tradition.

ASCII Constraint

EILEITHYIA

Stripped of its identity, the name was reduced to plain Latin letters. The original orthography — stress, length, breathing — was erased by systems that only understand A-Z.

Unicode Restoration

Eileíthyia

The Unicode restoration recovers what ASCII destroyed. This is philological accuracy — not decoration. The domain encodes to Punycode, but the browser displays the truth.

Punycode Encoding
eileíthyia.com → xn--eilethyia-j5a.com

The non-ASCII characters in Eileíthyia are encoded while the ASCII remains visible. To the DNS, it is Punycode. To humanity, it is Eileíthyia. PUNICODEX does not claim this domain is available; always verify status with a registrar.

Saying It
ay-LAY-tee-ee-ah · /ej. ˈlej. tʰy. i. a/

Derived from restored orthography (classical Attic values).

Tier Classification

Why Eileíthyia is classified as Tier-1

The Greek original Εἰλείθυια contains both stress AND at least one long vowel, and one historically dominant Unicode restoration exists. This is the full scholarly orthography — a single-tier Tier-1 name.
